biotools.summary: Short Python script (using Biopython library functions) to extract sequences from a FASTA, QUAL, FASTQ, or SFF file based on the list of IDs given by a column of a tabular file. The output order follows that of the tabular file, and if there are duplicates in the tabular file, there will be duplicates in the output sequence file.
